meta.name: Incident Lab Semantic Design Tokens
meta.description: Semantic light-first tokens for Incident Lab (Public Landing, Start/Resume, 02:04 Dana Alert, Night Incident Board, Rollback & Handoff, Morning Meeting Projector + HTML Panel, Morning Workstation, and Post-Incident Debrief/Rubric/Connections).

surface.$description: Primary card, modal, and panel surface

subtle.$description: Secondary grouping surface, code headers, table headers (slate-100)

elevated.$description: Elevated dialog, floating HUD pill, or popover surface

projector.$description: High-contrast dark slate canvas exclusively for the 3D in-room projector plane (readable from across the meeting room)

projectorSurface.$description: Card surface on the 3D in-room projector plane

glass.$description: Sticky header and floating HUD bar translucent surface

ink.$description: Primary body and heading ink (17.4:1 on surface)

inkSecondary.$description: Secondary body copy and active labels (10.3:1 on surface)

muted.$description: Helper text, metadata, captions (7.5:1 on surface, passes AAA)

onProjector.$description: Primary text on in-room projector surface

onProjectorMuted.$description: Secondary labels on in-room projector surface

subtle.$description: Default card, table row, and section divider border

strong.$description: Interactive control border, input border, and active card frame

accent.$description: Selected radio card or highlighted panel border

primary.$description: Primary interactive brand blue (6.7:1 contrast with white text)

primarySoft.$description: Soft tint for active tabs, badges, and selected states

focusRing.$description: 2px solid keyboard focus outline with 2px offset

ink.$description: Critical error rate / P0 alert / failed CI text (6.4:1 on white)

projector.$description: High-visibility coral red on dark projector canvas

ink.$description: Degraded state / loyalty discounts OFF / stale data text (5.1:1 on white)

projector.$description: High-visibility amber on dark projector canvas

ink.$description: Recovered / CI passing / verified PR text (5.2:1 on white)

projector.$description: High-visibility emerald on dark projector canvas

ink.$description: Active call / Tiger Data live / informational badge text

mono.$value: 'JetBrains Mono', 'Cascadia Code', 'Fira Code', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, monospace

fast.$description: Button, tab, pill, and row hover/focus feedback

panel.$description: Incoming call -> briefing morph, drawer/modal entrance, beat change

camera.$description: Seated monitor/projector frame handoff (disabled under prefers-reduced-motion)

prefetchIntentDelayMs.$description: Hover/focus intent delay before prefetching /start or next shift route
